# Object library credits

Most objects in the playground's library are ready-made assets, used under the
[Creative Commons Attribution 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) licence
they are published with (USDCraft-10K's under [Apache 2.0](https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0)).
We converted each to MuJoCo (`playground/tools/convert_simready.py`) and changed nothing else
(the coloured tube racks are one USDCraft rack in five colours). All rights stay with their authors.
Items marked "Built in-house" we modelled ourselves in Blender (`playground/tools/build_inhouse.py`).

- **NVIDIA SimReady** (nvidia): https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/simready-assets
- **Tripo SimReady** (tripo): https://huggingface.co/datasets/VAST-AI/Tripo-Simready-Assets
- **QUIKTECH SimReady** (quiktech): https://huggingface.co/datasets/quiktech/SimReady-Assets
- **NVIDIA USDCraft-10K (Apache 2.0)** (usdcraft): https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/USDCraft-10K
- **ForgeCAD SimReady** (forgecad): https://huggingface.co/datasets/ForgeCAD/simready-assets
- **Palatial NV Asset Library (Palatial Platforms)** (palatial): https://huggingface.co/datasets/PalatialSim/palatial-nv-asset-library
- **projectsim SimReady Assets (Kaedim)** (projectsim): https://huggingface.co/datasets/projectsim/simready-assets
- **Allsides SimReady Assets** (allsides): https://huggingface.co/datasets/ALLSIDES/simready-scanned-objects
- **NdotLight SimReady Assets** (ndotlight): https://huggingface.co/datasets/NdotLight/SimReady_Assets
- **Marso by M-XR SimReady assets** (mxr): https://huggingface.co/datasets/M-XR/marso-simready
- **Yamato Protec SimReady fire protection** (yamato): https://huggingface.co/datasets/YAMATOPROTEC/simready-fire-protection
- **atech SimReady assets** (atech): https://huggingface.co/datasets/atechdev/simready-assets
- **Google Scanned Objects, as MuJoCo models** (gso): https://github.com/kevinzakka/mujoco_scanned_objects (meshes and textures CC BY 4.0, Google; MJCF MIT, Kevin Zakka)
- **RoboCasa kitchen objects** (robocasa): https://github.com/robocasa/robocasa (assets CC BY 4.0; objects as RoboCasa loads them, `playground/tools/export_robocasa.py`); its Lightwheel objects and its fixtures are from NVIDIA's https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/PhysicalAI-Robotics-Manipulation-Objects-Kitchen-MJCF (CC BY 4.0)
